title: Restriction coherence of the fixed derived site comparison
statement: Let P be the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], j:U→X a morphism, W⊆X and O⊆U opens, k:O→W a morphism with k≫W.ι=O.ι≫j, and M a derived etale coefficient object on X. The composite of k* of the site comparison for W.ι, the site comparison for k, and the site-comparison image of the etale inverse-image square compositor [lem-trf-section-exceptional-fibre-coherence] equals the specified restrictionAlong isomorphism [def-pur-diagonal-counit-comparison-data] followed by the site comparison for O.ι at j*M. No Cartesian hypothesis on this square is required; empty opens are permitted.

source.place: Steps 1--2 and final canonicity paragraph; orientation-charts proof Step 3

proof.text: Substitute the name of the common composite into pullComparison_comp. This gives comparison compatibility for each factorization k≫W.ι and O.ι≫j, including the equality-congruence isomorphism.

Cancel the pro-etale pullback compositor. Expand the etale square compositor and cancel the image of its inverse/compositor pair under the comparison functor. Apply the second composition identity. Expand restrictionAlong and comparisonPull and cancel the remaining pro-etale compositor with its inverse.

theorem diagonalEtaleComparison_restriction (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (O : U.Opens)
    (k : O.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme) (hk : k ≫ W.ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (M : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule P.Coefficient X) :
    (OrientationRefinement.pull P k).map (Dnc.pullComparison P W.ι M).hom ≫
      (Dnc.pullComparison P k
        ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient W.ι).obj M)).hom ≫
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) O.toScheme).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (Etale.sectionCoherencePullbackIso P.Coefficient k W.ι O.ι j hk M).hom =
    ((OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P j W O k hk).app M).hom ≫
      (Dnc.pullComparison P O.ι
        ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient j).obj M)).hom
